Maximum capacity (Emax) 2000 kg up to and including 10000 kg
Minimum dead load 20 kg
Accuracy Class C
Rated Output 2,4 mV/V
Maximum number of load cell intervals (n) 4000
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval
Y = Emax / vmin		 9500
Ratio of minimum dead load output return
Z = Emax / (2 * DR)		 11000
Input impedance 1000 Ω ± 20 Ω
Temperature range - 10 °C / + 40 °C
Fraction pLC 0,7
Humidity Class CH
Safe overload 120 % of Emax
